title: Application to expand Flatiron District concession area, Manhattan
summary: The resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision on a Department of Transportation application to expand the boundaries of the Flatiron District concession area along parts of Broadway and Fifth Avenue between East 19th Street and West 31st Street in Manhattan. The expanded area covers about 162,345 square feet used for concession management and maintenance. The Council found the action would have no significant environmental impact.
